selectionPolicy: One smallest generated-token example per frozen test component; then public bytes and ID. Alphabetical family order if capped.

program.source: "use strict";async function run(){const reader=await host.openRead("input.txt");const chunk=await host.readChunk(reader);const writer=await host.openWrite("output.txt");await host.writeChunk(writer,chunk);await host.closeWrite(writer);await host.closeStream(reader);return chunk;}

"use strict";async function run(){let seen=0;const token=await host.listen("tick",n=>{seen+=n;host.store("event",seen);});await host.readAsync("events-complete");await host.unlisten(token);return seen;}
"use strict";function run(a,b){let n=a;let x=0;let y=1;while(n>0){const z=x+y;x=y;y=z;n=n-1;}return x+b;}
